record.scope: Fresh stability/liveness pass against solid-baseline; both minimalist frontends and source/state review of vipirc full UI

finding.cause: An ordinary edit left pending_review_draw set when returning from REVIEW before its frame could be queued. The poll loop treats that flag as immediate work in every mode, causing a permanent zero-timeout loop until the input state is reset.
finding.trigger: Pause terminal output, type an edit to queue a repaint, press Enter to open review, then type another character before the queued editor output drains. Resume output and leave the resulting editor idle.
finding.impact: Sustained CPU use on an otherwise idle client, including after terminal output recovers. This reproduction did not crash, send the unfinished draft, or corrupt its text.
finding.fix: The REVIEW-to-editor transition retires both review draw flags and wipes the obsolete SendPlan/token, matching confirmation cancellation's ownership cleanup.
finding.production_change: Six added lines in each shared src/idle.c; no UI/key/configuration policy changes.

record.targeted_state_cases: COMPOSE and COMMAND return with a real partial output write; exact remaining bytes preserved through short writes, EAGAIN, EINTR and EIO

limits: Native wide-curses development headers are unavailable. The full UI results use a private declaration shim with aborting renderer functions; they do not validate native curses ABI, drawing, terminal decoding by curses, or physical full-UI keys.
vipirc actual PTY tests execute its real minimal frontend and shared production main/core. Unavailable full-UI entrypoints are privately replaced with aborting stubs and are not exercised.
ASan/UBSan executions disable LeakSanitizer on this ptraced host; no leak-check pass is claimed.
No public IRC servers, accounts, or real credentials were used. Terminal CPU values are observations from bounded private Linux PTYs, not a general performance benchmark.
The existing documented full-curses synchronous-output limitation remains: a permanently stalled open terminal can delay that frontend's control poll. This pass does not redesign that output path.
record.state_source_note: State receipts hash their build inputs. They predate final version/help/manual edits, with the production frontend correction unchanged. test_idle_recovery-tested.c preserves the exact recovery test used; the shipped test adds only an early OpenBSD feature-test macro for header portability.
